Traits Eidolon, Stand · Size the size of its vessel (minimum Tiny) · Suggested Attacks the vessel's form (blade, wheel, hull)

Stand Attributes Con +2, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +0 · Skills Crafting, Thievery · Senses low-light vision · Speed 25 feet

Grades Durability must be A or B. Speed can't be A.

Examples Anubis, Emperor, Strength, Wheel of Fortune

Your stand lives inside an object: a weapon, a tool, later a vehicle. You fight with the bound weapon using the stand's numbers, Hidden in Plain Sight (4) lets it ambush from inside objects, Vessel Bond lets you act through it anywhere in range, and Living Vessel lets it jump between objects. Vessel Guard lets the vessel take blows for you, and it can't be disarmed while the stand is out, but if the vessel is broken the stand shuts off. Stand Guard and Precise Hands fit well. Pick this if you want a haunted-weapon or living-object fantasy built on ambushes and object tricks.

Initial (1st)—Vessel Each day, bind the stand to one object you hold or touch. When you Strike with a bound weapon, you can use the stand's attack modifier and damage. Act Together works as normal: the stand's single action is the vessel acting. While you hold the vessel, the stand acts from your space, for example a second Strike with the vessel at the stand's numbers (it swings itself, so this Strike takes a –2 penalty, and you and the stand share one multiple attack penalty) or a Stand Ability action. When the vessel isn't in your hands (set down, a vehicle, or an object it hides in with Hidden in Plain Sight), the stand acts from the vessel's space, which must be within your reach until 7th level (Vessel Bond). If the vessel is destroyed or taken from you, the stand unmanifests until you Manifest it into a new vessel. While the stand is manifested, the vessel can't be disarmed or taken from you against your will. The vessel has Hardness equal to half your level (minimum 1). Vessel Guard: reaction, once per round, when a Strike hits you, the vessel takes the blow and you reduce the damage by the vessel's Hardness.

7th—Vessel Bond You act through the vessel anywhere in range: when you Act Together, a vessel that isn't in your hands can take the stand's action from anywhere within your stand's Range. (The vessel's Hardness stays half your level.)

13th—Living Vessel Spend 1 action to move the stand into a new object, or bind it to a vehicle.
